div.head: II Cn 1
div.ab: Ðæt is þonne ærest, þæt ic wylle, þæt man rihte laga upp arære ⁊ æghwylce unlaga georne afylle, ⁊ þæt man áweodige ⁊ awyrtwalige æghwylc unriht, swa man geornost mæge, of þysum earde, ⁊ arære up Godes riht;

Þæt is ðonne æryst, þæt ic wylle, þæt man rihte lage up arǽre ⁊ æghwylce unlage georne afylle, þæt man awéodige ⁊ awyrtwalie æghwylc unriht, swa man geornost mæge, of ðissum earde, ⁊ arǽre up Godes riht;

Þæt is þanne ærost, þæt ic wylle, þæt man rihte laga upp arære ⁊ æghwilce unlaga georne afylle, ⁊ þæt man áweodige ⁊ áwrytwalige æghwylc unriht, swa man geornest mage, of ðissum hearde, ⁊ arare up Godes riht;

[1] And witena gerædnes is, þæt man rihte laga upp arǽre and æghwilce unlaga georne afille, and þæt man awéodige ⁊ awyrtwalige æghwilc unriht, swa man geornost mæge, of þisan earde, ⁊ arære up Godes riht;

Inprimis uolo, ut iustę leges erigantur et iniuste subuertantur, et omnis iniusticia, quanta possumus obseruantia, de finibus nostris sarculetur et explantetur, et Dei iusticia modis omnibus exaltetur.
Inprimis, ut iustę leges erigantur, et iniustę deprimantur et abiciantur;

[1] Primum quidem est, quod uolo, ut recta lex erigatur, et omnis iniuria deiciatur, et omnis iniusticia emundetur et eradicetur, in quantum humana ratio et diligentia ualeat, ab hac patria, Deique rectitudo erigatur.

Þæt is ðonne æryst, þæt ic wylle þæt man rihte lage up arǽre ⁊ æghwylce unlage georne afylle, þæt man awéodige ⁊ awyrtwalie æghwylc unriht, swa man geornost mæge, of [ð]issum earde ⁊ arǽre up Godes riht.

Ðæt is þonne ærest: þæt ic wylle þæt man rihte laga upp arære and æghwylc unlaga georne afylle, and þæt man aweodige and awyrtwalige æghwylc unriht, swa man geornost mæge, of þysum earde, and arære up Godes riht.

Nämlich zuerst nun, dass ich will (Und Beschluss der Witan ist D), dass man echte Rechtsverordnungen aufrichte und jeden Rechtsmissbrauch eifrig abschaffe, und dass man jedes Unrecht, wie man eifrigst vermag, aus diesem Lande ausreute und entwurzele und Gottes Recht aufrichte,

Namely, first, that I will (And it is the decision of the witan, D) that just laws be set up and every unjust law eagerly suppressed, and that every injustice be weeded out and rooted up from this country as eagerly as possible, and God's law be raised up,

The first provision is, that I desire that justice be promoted and every injustice zealously suppressed, that every illegality be rooted up and eradicated from this land with the utmost diligence, and the law of God promoted.

This is foremost, then: I desire just laws to be upheld and all wrongdoing to be entirely brought low, and all injustice to be weeded out from this land and eradicated as zealously as possible, and the law of God to be exalted.
